ideas.pitch: A 2D puzzle platformer where the world generation and physics pivot mid-stream based on live spectator chat inputs, adapting the game state in real-time.
ideas.title: ChronoCanvas: Dynamic World-Model Narrative Game
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy technical ambition inspired by recent continuous generative video world model winners, captivating judges looking for novel runtime engine mechanics.

ideas.pitch: A Unity-based narrative RPG mod that hooks local LLMs via Python bindings to let players converse with non-player characters using real-time voice input.
ideas.title: Echoes of Incarnia: AI Voice NPC Interactor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates hard engineering integration between game engines and live speech-to-text models, following proven patterns from real-time AI character hackathon wins.

ideas.pitch: An interactive Ren'Py visual novel focused on local resource management and water conservation puzzles, featuring custom illustrated assets and branching logic.
ideas.title: AquaGuardian: Eco-Educational Visual Novel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted game jam format execution with an educational spin that historically sweeps social impact tracks and hooks student judges.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser-based strategy mini-game where players deploy autonomous reinforcement learning agents that battle using simplified MOBA mechanics.
ideas.title: Dota Tactics: Autonomous Minion Autochess
ideas.why_it_could_win: Shows advanced systems programming and machine learning integration scaled down neatly into a hackathon-friendly time frame.

ideas.pitch: A retro 8-bit arcade platformer built in React that integrates simulated blockchain token drops and instant minigame transactions on every level clearance.
ideas.title: TokenTumble: Retro Arcade Tokenomics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Hits the sweet spot of polished retro styling combined with functional ledger mechanics that previously won game jam prizes.
